titulo_es: Who does what? · Public documents and decisions

texto: In a public document it locates authority, decision, date of entry into force, persons concerned and available resource. The nominal style condenses actions; it identifies who should perform them.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
